title: Commercial quantity vs small quantity - why it changes everything
p1:
A few grams can completely change the legal consequences of a case.

Many people think the amount of a prohibited substance only affects the punishment. But the quantity itself can decide the entire direction of a case.
p2:
The surprising part is that the law does not treat every possession in the same way. There is a clear difference between 'small quantity' and 'commercial quantity'.

Small quantity generally refers to a lower amount where the law may provide comparatively different treatment. Commercial quantity means an amount above a legally specified limit, and it can lead to much stricter consequences.
p3:
This distinction matters because it can affect bail, punishment, and how the prosecution approaches the case. The same substance, but a different quantity, can create a completely different legal situation.

A simple measurement can become one of the most important facts in a case. That is why quantity is not just a number; it can change everything.
conclusion: Did you know that the quantity involved can have such a major impact on the legal outcome of a case? What are your thoughts on this distinction?
